answer_2.quote: We evaluate six recent models on our tests, and compare them to human accuracy... using several metrics: overall accuracy, self-consistency and comprehensive accuracy.

answer_4.quote: We sample 100 question pairs (200 questions) from each question type for the 6 tests and procure 5 annotations per question from workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk... Human answers are the majority vote among the 5 workers; questions failing to reach majority or with ambiguous as the majority are always counted against accuracy.
answer_4.guideline: Workers provide answers (yes/no/choice or ambiguous) for each question; the majority vote determines the final human label.
